page_title: BOU 1-1 NEW | Bournemouth v Newcastle 25/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
90+5' Referee David Coote has finally had enough of Andoni Iraola and brandishes a yellow card at him!
90+5' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Bournemouth due to a handball in the build-up play.
90+3' Wait! Referee David Coote has indicated he is going to review the Bournemouth goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.

90+3' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Lewis Cook. His header bounced off the ground and went inside the right post behind the goalkeeper. It's 2:1.
90+3' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) steps up to send the ball in.

90+2' Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the roof of the net. However, Nick Pope anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. The referee signals a corner kick to Bournemouth.
90+1' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

90+1' Neto makes a brilliant save! Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the top left corner but is saved by the keeper! Newcastle have a corner.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' A substitution has been made. Anthony Gordon goes off and Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) comes on.
89' Yellow card. Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
88' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
87' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
86' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a change. Adam Smith (Bournemouth) replaces Julian Araujo.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Daniel Jebbison (Bournemouth) will replace Marcus Tavernier.
85' The linesman makes the right call and Bournemouth will have a corner.
84' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
83' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
83' The corner from Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is cleared away by the defence. Newcastle will take a corner kick.

83' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Newcastle will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

82' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) rises above the defence and heads a precise cross towards the left post. His effort, however, is blocked by Neto, who pulls off a stunning save! The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Newcastle.
82' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
81' The ball possession is 46:54. The statistic for corner kicks – 6:4.
80' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
79' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Bournemouth earn a corner.
78' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
76' 1 - 1 Goal! Harvey Barnes puts a cross into the box and finds Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the middle of the net. He makes it 1:1.
75' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
72' Here is a change. Evanilson is going off and Andoni Iraola gives the last tactical orders to Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth).
72' Substitution. Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) in, Justin Kluivert out.
71' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) jumps for a cross and glances a header towards the left side of the goal, but it's meat and drink for Neto and he comfortably saves.
70' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) receives a pinpoint pass, takes one touch and produces a shot. It's a few inches shy of ending inside the left post. A great effort, though!
70' Eddie Howe has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) replacing Sean Longstaff.
69' Lloyd Kelly will be replaced by Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd).
69' Corner kick. Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is ready to send the ball into the box.
68' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag and Bournemouth will take a corner.

67' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) is free in the box and Alexander Isak finds him with a pass, but his powerful shot skims just past the right post. Good chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
66' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alex Scott (Bournemouth) replaces Ryan Christie.
64' Antoine Semenyo plays a lovely pass into Evanilson (Bournemouth), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the left post.
63' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

63' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. Bournemouth will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
60' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
59' Great solo effort from Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort rose just over the bar.
58' Eddie Howe has decided to substitute Jacob Murphy and he is replaced by Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd).
58' Today's match ends for Valentino Livramento who will be replaced by Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd).
57' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) will take a corner kick.
57' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared. It will be a corner kick for Bournemouth.
56' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.

53' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) receives a pin-point pass in the middle of the pitch which gives him a great opportunity to score. He is unfazed by the distance and slams the ball towards the goal. He is unlucky as he hits one of his own teammates.

52' Evanilson (Bournemouth) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Nick Pope.

52' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. David Coote blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Newcastle will take a free kick.
51' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.

50' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick.
48' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
48' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. Newcastle force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
48' PENALTY APPEAL after Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
46' Nick Pope displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Evanilson (Bournemouth) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
45+1' Neat passing move from Bournemouth in order to create new attacking opportunities.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
42' David Coote blows for a foul after Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
41' A spell of possession for Bournemouth in an attempt to control the game.
40' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) picks up an injury. Evanilson (Bournemouth) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
37' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Antoine Semenyo is the provider as he slips the ball to Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) who simply steers it home from close range. It's 1:0.
36' A clumsy foul by Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) and David Coote blows his whistle.
35' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards wide of the left post.
34' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) takes it short.
33' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall. Bournemouth force a corner. They send men into the box.
33' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
32' Dangerous play by Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd). David Coote blows his whistle for a foul. Bournemouth win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
31' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
30' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) plays a through ball but overhits it.
29' David Coote has a clear sight and sees a foul from Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd). Bournemouth are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
28' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) tries his luck with a shot from long range, and his superb effort rattles the crossbar!
26' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
24' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 1:2. The shots on goal statistics – 1:1.
23' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) trips an opposition player and David Coote signals a foul.
22' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
20' Evanilson (Bournemouth) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper is equal to it!
19' Great teamplay by Bournemouth as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
17' David Coote blows his whistle for a foul after Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) hacks down one of his opponents.
16' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
14' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
13' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
13' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Neto.
12' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
11' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
11' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

10' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Newcastle win a corner.
8' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar.
8' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
8' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick.
7' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
6' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee David Coote signals.
6' Evanilson (Bournemouth) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
5' Evanilson (Bournemouth) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
3' Newcastle keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
1' The ball is cleared after Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bournemouth will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's David Coote.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
